title: Fourth-order compact finite difference methods for 2D and 3D nonlinear convection-diffusion-reaction equations
summary:
In this paper, we first consider linear 2D and 3D convection-diffusion-reaction equations $-
abla\cdot (κ
abla u) + { m v} \cdot 
abla u + λu = φ$ and $u_t - 
abla\cdot (κ
abla u) + { m v} \cdot 
abla u + λu = φ$, where all $κ>0, { m v}, λ, φ$ are smooth variable functions. We derive fourth-order compact 9-point (2D) and 19-point (3D) finite difference methods (FDMs) to solve linear time-independent equations.
